values.note: Daily rate, tax included, for 2 adults: summer (May 1 - Oct 31) $50, winter (Nov 1 - Apr 30) $60; additional guests $2.50/day. Weekly $300/$360, monthly $615/$750 plus electric; long-term RV sites (lease required) $585/month.

note: Primarily a 55+ mobile-home and RV community in Winter Haven, part of Southern Charm Mobile Home & RV Communities; families and younger guests may stay up to two weeks. Mobile homes are sold on site. --Claude
summary: Operator site + its Park With Us booking page: daily $50 summer / $60 winter (tax included, 2 adults), full hookups 30/50-amp, back-in and pull-through sites, laundry; books online (Park With Us) or by phone, so platform phone -> operator with the booking URL; the 2-week limit is for under-55 guests, so max_stay_nights 14 cleared. Not stated: site count (163 left as derived), max rig length (the home page says both 'up to 42ft' and 'all sizes of Motorhomes'), season. Note rewritten.
